Missing Strict-Transport-Security.suggestion: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security' with a long max-age to enforce HTTPS and prevent downgrade attacks.

Missing X-Frame-Options.suggestion: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN', or a CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive, to prevent clickjacking.

Missing X-Content-Type-Options.suggestion: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to prevent MIME-sniffing attacks.

Missing Referrer-Policy.suggestion: Add 'Referrer-Policy' to control what information is sent in the Referer header.

Missing Permissions-Policy.suggestion: Add 'Permissions-Policy' to restrict access to powerful features like geolocation, camera, etc.

Legacy XSS-Protection enabled.suggestion: Set 'X-XSS-Protection: 0' or remove the header. The legacy XSS filter has been removed from modern browsers and could introduce issues of its own; rely on a strong Content-Security-Policy instead.

Scanner Error.suggestion: Scanner encountered an error while fetching headers.
